title: Your Non-EU Student Arrival Roadmap
summary: Your top priority is to validate your VLS-TS. University registration, Ameli, and CAF are currently blocked by missing documents or earlier steps.

steps.title: Validate VLS-TS
steps.explanation: You arrived in France with a VLS-TS and have not validated it yet.
steps.next_action: Validate your VLS-TS on the official foreigner administration portal.

steps.title: Complete CVEC and university registration
steps.explanation: Your university registration appears incomplete because CVEC is not done and you do not yet have a certificat de scolarité.
steps.next_action: Complete CVEC or obtain your CVEC attestation, then finish administrative registration at your institution.

steps.title: Register for Ameli health insurance
steps.explanation: Ameli registration appears blocked because visa validation and university registration evidence are not ready yet.
steps.next_action: After validating your VLS-TS and obtaining your certificat de scolarité, register through the dedicated Ameli foreign-student portal.

steps.title: Open bank account and get RIB
steps.explanation: Opening a bank account may be harder until you have proof of residence and proof of enrollment.
steps.next_action: Prepare identification, proof of residence, and proof of enrollment or student card. If you lack permanent housing, ask your institution whether its international office address can be used temporarily.

steps.title: Secure permanent housing
steps.explanation: You currently do not have permanent housing, which blocks some later steps such as CAF preparation.
steps.next_action: Secure longer-term housing and keep your rental contract or housing certificate.

steps.title: Prepare CAF housing aid
steps.explanation: CAF preparation is blocked because you do not yet have a RIB or rental contract.
steps.next_action: Get a RIB and rental contract before starting detailed CAF preparation.

steps.title: Track residence renewal
steps.explanation: Your visa expiry date is known, so this can be tracked as a future reminder.
steps.next_action: Track your renewal window from 4 months before expiry to 2 months before expiry.

safety_disclaimer: This roadmap helps you organize your administrative steps. It does not submit official applications, replace official portals, or guarantee eligibility, legal status, or approval.
